direction.camera: Guide attention with product fidelity; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: balance true product detail with a short readable offer; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with clear offer; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with quiet premium.
direction.lighting: warm retail softbox; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: matte packaging and tactile stock; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around trustworthy scale; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use product fidelity,clear offer,tactile detail,calm comparison,trustworthy scale,quiet premium as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
